Ben —

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed the notice and your draft redlines. High-level recommendations:

- Offer a narrow indemnity tied to proven third-party claims of direct infringement by Redwood-delivered source code or models; exclude open-source/third-party libraries and any customer modifications.
- Add a notice-and-cooperation clause: Acme must provide claim details and allow us to investigate and control defense; we will not be bound to indemnify where Acme has modified the integration or failed to follow mitigation.
- Cap our defense obligations for Order Form-level indemnity to the total fees paid in the prior 12 months (or an alternative cap).
- Add a termination/mitigation ladder: if claim is substantiated we propose a remediation window (30 days) and escrow/replace options rather than immediate termination.

I’ve converted those into markup and some fallback language. Two asks for sales:
1) Approve offering a monetary cap (I drafted the cap as prior-12-months fees);
2) Confirm whether we can offer a narrowly worded indemnity for "Redwood-provided deliverables" only (i.e., not models downloaded or third-party components).

If you approve, I’ll generate: (A) a clean redline to share with Acme, and (B) a short cover letter LegalOps can rely on.
